top_signals.title: Commission unveils 2027 work programme for a stronger and sovereign Europe and reports on simplification efforts
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 04 Nov 2026 Today, the Commission adopted its 2027 work programme, setting out its main legislative and non-legislative initiatives for the year ahead. It is accompanied by the 2026 annual progress report on simplification, implementation and enforcement, taking stock of progress towards simpler EU rules and more effective results on the ground.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: San Francisco’s BART Gets Lifeline as Voters Approve New Tax
top_signals.summary: The struggling public-transit system in the San Francisco Bay Area received a financial lifeline Tuesday, with voters passing a proposed sales tax to fund the region’s trains, buses and ferries.
